effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with ＜Save＞ in its text, by suspending this Tamer and placing 1 card from under one of your Tamers under that Digimon as its bottom digivolution card, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
